company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC, publishing at cnas.org. It describes itself as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

Its published work addresses artificial intelligence as a national security subject. One report considers near-term opportunities for integrating agentic AI capabilities across the Department of War. Other commentary covers an upcoming Trump-Xi summit and the disappointment it is likely to bring to leaders of top AI labs that have called for urgent, coordinated pacing of frontier AI progress. A further piece argues for lengthening the United States' AI lead by expanding rather than weakening technology protections, starting with closing three priority gaps, the first being remote access.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the organization.
